item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
There's so much GoI history that we're just sort of told about in broad strokes or blacked-out SCP numbers, or is confined completely to Tales, especially with the non-SCP-making GoIs.

We actually had an entire GOI-based contest to expand these horizons! Take a look at the main contest page, and it'll link you to all the cool GOI hubs that were created.

From these hubs, you can access GOI-format documents, some of which contain information on anomalous entities, objects, or procedures that the Foundation has never encountered.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
The song is a cool idea and I would be happy with it on its own, but the most unique and exciting thing about the article is the ending. There's so much GoI history that we're just sort of told about in broad strokes or blacked-out SCP numbers, or is confined completely to Tales, especially with the non-SCP-making GoIs. I've seen numerous SCP articles that say the item was recovered from a GoI by the Foundation, but this is the first one I can remember that says the reverse.

If the Foundation has been defending their stuff from groups like the Chaos Insurgency and Global Occult Coalition for decades, there should probably be more recorded instances of those groups actually getting their hands on some stuff- and not just blacked-out references to nonexistent SCP designations, either. There are articles for objects the Foundation has discovered but hasn't contained yet; if there are objects it's discovered, contained, and then lost, those objects should have articles too.

Note: I haven't read every single article. Feel free to let me know if I'm wrong about the absence of these things, or if I need to take this discussion to its own thread.
